source: NIST Atomic Spectra Database (A. Kramida, Yu. Ralchenko, J. Reader and the NIST ASD Team), https://physics.nist.gov/asd — U.S. Government work, public domain
query: https://physics.nist.gov/cgi-bin/ASD/lines1.pl · spectra=<El> I · line_out=1 · show_av=3 (vacuum, all wavelengths) · unit=1 (nm) · format=3 (tab)
keep: A_ki known, both configurations, rel. intensity >= the element median (else A_ki >= its median), <= 160 per element
